title: Initial Compass - modular checklist canvas and contextual empty-state visuals
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design and deliver a modular onboarding "Compass" that surfaces a compact, scannable checklist and contextual empty-state illustrations for first-run Console users. Deliverables: Figma master file with tokenized components, high-fidelity PNG/SVG export for engineering, annotated responsive states (desktop/tablet/mobile), and 6 screenshot-ready compositions for release notes and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a tokenized Checklist Canvas component with configurable steps and progress states
Three responsive variants (desktop/tablet/mobile) exported and approved
Empty-state illustration system (primary/secondary/compact) with accessibility alt text and color token mapping
6 annotated screenshots uploaded to Drive and linked in PR for release-2026.03
Design handoff includes interaction specs for microtips, dismiss behaviors, and analytics hook points
design_notes: Use single-column compact checklist for <= 600px; two-column for >= 960px
Checklist items tokenized: title, body, status chip, CTA button — avoid nested controls
Empty-state illustrations follow brand neutral palette; provide high-contrast variant for WCAG AA
Microtips should be optional, dismissible per session and have a max of 3 appearances
Prioritize PNG exports for screenshots to preserve subtle shadows; provide SVGs for code integration
